limitations: Nominal simulated frequency is not a physical timing/Fmax claim.
Independent zero/one-cycle memory ports replace DDR, its arbitration, CDC and board adapters collectively.
One-cycle response is a latency model, not a placed/routed BRAM implementation.
Upstream default has a different multiply/divide implementation from the physical core.
UART MMIO is immediate; UART/reporting are outside timed workload.
One performance and one validation run per deterministic simulation model; all meet ten simulated seconds and reference CRCs.
